strings.string: And the angel being come in, said unto her: Hail, full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him up in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger…
Lk 2:7
…my eyes have seen thy salvation, Which thou hast prepared before the face of all peoples…
And he said to them: How is it that you sought me? did you not know, that I must be about my father's business?
Father, if thou wilt, remove this chalice from me: but yet not my will, but thine be done.
Then therefore, Pilate took Jesus, and scourged him.
And the soldiers platting a crown of thorns, put it upon his head; and they put on him a purple garment.
And bearing his own cross, he went forth to that place which is called Calvary, but in Hebrew Golgotha.
And Jesus crying out with a loud voice, said: Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit. And saying this, he gave up the ghost.
Why seek you the living with the dead? He is not here, but is risen.
And when he had said these things, while they looked on, he was raised up: and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Acts 1:9
…And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they began to speak with divers tongues, according as the Holy Ghost gave them to speak.
Acts 2:4
Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
And a great sign appeared in heaven: A woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars…
Apoc 12:1
And behold a voice from heaven, saying: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
His mother saith to the waiters: Whatsoever he shall say to you, do ye.
Jn 2:5
The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel.
And there was a cloud overshadowing them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying: This is my most beloved son; hear ye him.
Mk 9:6
This is my body, which is given for you. Do this for a commemoration of me.
